answer.answer: Both the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences [E01] and the IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D. [E03] are implemented by the Indian Council Of Agricultural Research under the Department of Agriculture Research and Education [E01][E03], which is part of the Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. They are related as centrally-administered schemes designed to support postgraduate students pursuing higher education in agricultural and veterinary sciences through this common department.
